dimensions.assessment: Affects owners and operators of over-the-road buses and school buses nationwide, as well as state and local governments enforcing idling rules.

dimensions.assessment: Provides relief from idling restrictions and civil actions under a 15-minute threshold for bus operations, and terminates certain state bounty programs.
dimensions.evidence: no State or political subdivision thereof may implement or maintain any program that provides monetary compensation

importance_detail.rationale: The BUSES Act amends the Clean Air Act to prohibit states and local governments from enforcing engine idling restrictions of less than 15 minutes on over-the-road buses and school buses, and prohibits bounty-based enforcement programs for such violations. This creates a targeted, permanent legal change affecting bus operators and state implementation plans.
